abstract: A 25-year-old man was first seen complaining of impotence and found to have a pituitary tumour and hyperprolactinaemia. Both testes were small and atrophic, but a testicular tumour was not apparent. Biopsy of the right testis was performed, and the pathology report described thickening of the seminiferous tubule walls and impaired spermatogenesis. The patient refused to undergo an operation for his pituitary tumour and was lost to follow-up. 5 years later, the same patient presented with enlargement of his right testis, and this and the pituitary tumour were excised. The testicular tumour was classified as seminoma, and the pituitary tumour as an adenoma with low malignancy. Re-examination of the previous specimen of his right testis revealed foci of carcinoma-in-situ. This is an additional example of the growth of an invasive germ cell tumour from non-invasive carcinoma-in-situ of the testis.
abstract_ja: 25歳の男性が、インポテンツと下垂体腫瘍・高プロラクチン血症を主訴に受診した。両精巣は小さく萎縮していたが、精巣腫瘍は明らかではなかった。右精巣の生検が施行され、病理所見では精細管壁の肥厚と精子形成障害が記載された。患者は下垂体腫瘍に対する手術を拒否し、フォローアップから脱落した。5年後、同患者は右精巣の腫大を呈して受診し、この精巣と下垂体腫瘍が摘出された。精巣腫瘍はセミノーマと分類され、下垂体腫瘍は低悪性度の腺腫と分類された。以前の右精巣標本を再検討したところ、上皮内癌の病巣が認められた。これは、非浸潤性の精巣上皮内癌から浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍が発生する例がさらに加わったことを示す。
